# Config

The set of user-defined build values.

```rux
pub struct Config {}
```

Carries no fields: the values live in the build rather than in the value, and are reached through the two queries
below. [`#config`](/docs/api/core/config#config-constant) is the only instance.

## Methods

<h3 id="get"><code>Get</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Get(self: &Config, name: char8[..]) -> char8[..]
```

The value defined for `name`, or an empty slice when none was.
`self` is borrowed and `name` must be a string literal, since this is answered while compiling. Returns a
borrowed view of the build's own storage, which outlives the program.
An absent name and a name defined as empty both yield an empty slice; use [`Has`](/docs/api/core/config#has) to tell them apart.
Cannot fail. Costs nothing in the built program.

| Name   | Type        | Description            |
| ------ | ----------- | ---------------------- |
| `name` | `char8[..]` | the build value's name |

**Returns**: its value, or an empty slice when the build defines none

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Core/Src/Config.rux#L23)

<h3 id="has"><code>Has</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Has(self: &Config, name: char8[..]) -> bool
```

Whether `name` was defined at all, whatever its value.
`self` is borrowed and `name` must be a string literal. Answered while compiling.
Cannot fail. Costs nothing in the built program.

| Name   | Type        | Description            |
| ------ | ----------- | ---------------------- |
| `name` | `char8[..]` | the build value's name |

**Returns**: whether the build defines it

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Core/Src/Config.rux#L31)
